sourceDescription: Troop silhouettes generated from user-supplied image references and traced from the approved bitmap masters. Original authorship and publication were not independently verified.

/vector/troop/saluting-shield-bearer.svg.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 12, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.6, followed by the SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the troop optimization profile.
/vector/troop/saluting-shield-bearer.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Essential gaps remain transparent.
/vector/troop/saluting-shield-bearer.svg.collection: Troops, supplied by the existing vector-category fallback.
